jobs.description: Are you looking for a new position as a warehouse employee in day shift? Then read on! We are looking for a motivated warehouse employee for Cordstrap in Oostrum. Apply Are you looking for a new challenge as a warehouse employee and do you have experience with the EPT? Then apply immediately and we will contact you! As a Mechanical Assembly Technician, you will work on the assembly of high-quality machines and technical systems used within the high-tech industry. From the first components to a fully operational machine, you play an important role throughout the entire build process. Together with colleagues from different technical disciplines, you ensure that every machine is assembled accurately, tested thoroughly and prepared for delivery. No project is the same: one day you may be assembling complex modules in the workshop, while the next day you may support installation or commissioning activities at a customer location. Your responsibilities include: Assembling machines, modules and technical installations. Installing and connecting mechanical and electrical components. Testing machines and checking functionality and quality. Reading and applying technical drawings and work instructions. Identifying and resolving technical issues during assembly. Contributing ideas to improve assembly processes. Working closely with colleagues to successfully complete projects. Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will join an innovative organization where technology, craftsmanship and personal development are key. You will work on challenging projects within high-tech machine building and have the opportunity to continuously expand your technical skills. We offer: A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. 25 vacation days and additional ADV days. A solid pension scheme. Travel allowance. Training opportunities and possibilities for professional growth. Working with modern tools and the latest technologies. A collaborative working environment with skilled and enthusiastic colleagues. The opportunity for a permanent contract after a successful probation period. Functie-eisen You are a technically skilled professional who enjoys building advanced machines and solving technical challenges. You work accurately, take responsibility for your work and enjoy collaborating with others todeliver high-quality solutions. You have: A technical MBO-level education, preferably in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a similar field. Experience as a Mechanical Assembly Technician, Machine Builder or in a similar technical role. Experience reading technical drawings. Strong mechanical skills; electrical knowledge is an advantage. A structured and quality-focused approach to your work. Good command of the Dutch and/or English language. A proactive attitude and a team-oriented mindset. Hier kom je te werken Through us, you will join an innovative organization active in high-tech machine building. The company develops, builds and delivers advanced machines and technical systems for leading companies within the technology industry. You will work in a modern environment where craftsmanship, innovation and collaboration come together. There is plenty of room for personal development, and you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects where you can see the direct impact of your work.
